build_basic_attention_module: build a BasicAttention module with cosine similarity to compute attention weights between query and key tensors
build_multihead_attention_module: build a MultiHeadAttention module with configurable heads and dropout for transformer self-attention
test_basic_attention_forward: test the BasicAttention forward pass with query and key tensors and an optional mask
test_multihead_attention_forward: test the MultiHeadAttention forward pass with query, key, value tensors and incremental state caching
refactor_multihead_attention_incremental: refactor the MultiHeadAttention reorder_incremental_state method to reorder cached key, value, and mask tensors by batch index
